newsitem.title: USA: Unitrin Q4 revenues up on segment gains.
newsitem.headline: Unitrin Q4 revenues up on segment gains.

text.p: Unitrin Inc said Tuesday higher revenues in its Property and Casualty Insurance and Consumer Finance segments helped the company post higher revenues and net income in the fourth quarter.

Unitrin reported total revenues of $381.6 million in the quarter, versus $380.5 million in the fourth quarter of 1995. Unitrin's net income totaled $39.5 million, or $1.06 a share, compared to $37.8 million, or $0.97 a share, a year ago.
The company said Property and Casualty Insurance revenues were up by $5 million in the period, while Consumer Finance revenues climbed $3.1 million compared to a year ago.
Unitrin is an insurance holding company.
Its shares closed down 1-1/4 Tuesday at 52-7/8.
